name: 六级核心词
description: 大学英语六级词汇精编表（来源：english-wordlists/CET6_edited.txt），按 COCA 词频排序

words.meaning: v. 1. (报刊等)发行，发布，颁布 2. 排出，(使)流出 3. 分配 n. 1. 发行物，(报刊)期号 2. 问题，议题，争论点 3. (水、血等)流出，放出 4. 河口，出口
words.example: As employers we need to be seen to be addressing (= dealing with) these issues sympathetically.  作为雇主，我们需要让大家知道我们在处理这些问题时富有同情心。

words.meaning: n. 1. 团体，社区，(政治)共同体 2. 同一地区的全体居民，公众
words.example: He's well-known in the local community.  他在当地非常闻名。

words.meaning: n. 1. 力，力量，力气 2. 势力，威力，影响力 3. 军队，兵力，队伍 4. 武力，暴力，压力 5. 效力，约束力，控制力 6. (pl)三军，军队 || by force凭借暴力，强迫地  v. 1. 强迫，强加，逼 2. 用强暴手段得到，促使
words.example: The force of the wind had brought down a great many trees in the area.  强风刮倒了这一地区的许多树木。

words.meaning: n. 1. 步骤，过程 2. 工序，制作法 || in the process of在…过程中  v. 加工，处理
words.example: Increasing the number of women in top management jobs will be a slow process.  增加高级管理职位女性的人数将是一个缓慢的过程。

words.meaning: v. 1. 停留，留下 2. 仍然是，保持
words.example: The doctor ordered him to remain in bed for a few days.  医生嘱咐他要继续卧床几天。

words.meaning: adj. 1. 经济(上)的，经济学的 2. 合算的，有利可图的
words.example: The country has been in a very poor economic state ever since the decline of its two major industries.  自从这个国家的两大主要产业衰退后，其经济一直萎靡不振。

words.meaning: adj. 军事的，军用的，军人的 n. 军人，军方
words.example: The military has opposed any cuts in defence spending.  军方反对任何裁减国防开支的举措。

words.meaning: adj. 联邦的，联盟的，联合的
words.example: the federal government  联邦政府

words.meaning: n. 方案，规划，工程，项目 [prəˈdʒekt] v. 1. 发射，投掷，投(影) 2. 使凸出，突出 3. 规划，设计
words.example: Her latest project is a film based on the life of a nineteenth-century music hall star.  她最近计划拍摄一部关于某位19世纪歌厅歌星一生的影片。

words.meaning: n. 1. 法院，法庭 2. (网球等)球场 v. 求爱
words.example: Protestors gathered outside the court to await the verdict.  抗议者聚集在法庭外等待判决。

words.meaning: n. 1. 外形，体形，轮廓 2. 数字，位数，符号 3. 图形，图表 4. 人物，身份，地 位 5. 价格，估价 v. 1. 扮演角色，塑造，描述 2. 计算 3. 估计，以为，想象 || figure out ①想出，理解，明白②计算出，解决
words.example: Can you read this figure? Is it a three or an eight?  你能认出这个数字吗？是3还是8？

words.meaning: v. 1. 叙述，描写，形容 2. 描绘，画，把…说成
words.example: Could you describe your attacker?  你能描述一下袭击者的样子吗？

words.meaning: n. 1. 根据，证据，证明 2. 证词
words.example: The police have found no evidence of a terrorist link with the murder.  警方没有发现任何证据证明这宗谋杀案和恐怖分子有关。

words.meaning: n. 1. 文化，精神文明 2. 教养，陶冶，修养 3. 栽培，养殖，培养
words.example: She's studying modern Japanese language and culture.  她在研究现代日本语言和文化。

words.meaning: adj. 可用的，可得到的
words.example: Is this dress available in a larger size?  这件衣服有更大一号的吗？

words.meaning: n. 1. (行政)管理 2. (AmE)政府
words.example: Teachers complain that more of their time is taken up with administration than with teaching.  教师抱怨他们花在行政工作上的时间超过了教学的时间。

words.meaning: n. 1. (代表)大会 2. (cap)国会，议会 3. 聚会，会议
words.example: Congress has rejected the recent presidential proposal on firearms.  国会否决了总统最近关于枪支的提案。

words.meaning: n. 1. 经济(体系) 2. 节约，节省，简练 adj. 便宜的，经济的，二等的
words.example: Tourism contributes millions of pounds to the country's economy.  旅游业为这个国家带来数百万英镑的经济收入。UK noun

words.meaning: adj. 1. 目前运用的，广泛流通的 2. 现在的，目前的 n. 1. 水流，气流 2. 思潮，倾向
words.example: Have you seen the current issue of (= the most recently published) Vogue magazine?  最新一期《时尚》杂志你看过了吗？

words.meaning: v. 1. 涉及，使卷入，连累 2. 包括，包围，需要
words.example: The second accident involved two cars and a lorry.  第二次意外涉及两辆小汽车和一辆大卡车。

words.meaning: n. 1. 安全，平安 2. 治安防卫(部门) 3. 债券，股票
words.example: The station was closed for two hours because of a security alert.  由于有安全警报，车站关闭了两小时。

words.meaning: n. 行为，举止
words.example: His behavior at work improved after the talk.  谈话之后他的工作表现好转了。

words.meaning: n. 1. 履行，执行 2. 演出
words.example: Some athletes take drugs to improve their performance.  有些运动员为了提升表现而服用药物。

words.meaning: n. 1. 著者，作家 2. 创造者，创始人，发起人
words.example: He is the author of two books on French history.  他是两部法国历史著作的作者。

words.meaning: v. 1. 代表 2. 描绘，表现 3. 象征，表示 4. 意味着，相当于…
words.example: They chose a famous barrister to represent them in court.  他们选了一位著名律师为他们出庭辩护。

words.meaning: n. 1. 焦点，焦距，聚焦 2. 中心，集中点 v. 1. 聚焦，集中 2. 调节…的焦距
words.example: The main focus of interest at the fashion show was Christian Lacroix's outrageous evening wear.  时装表演上人们兴趣的主要焦点是克里斯琴‧拉克鲁瓦那身奇特的晚装。

words.meaning: v. 1. 涉及，影响 2. 使关心，使挂念，使担心 || as far as…be concerned关于…，至于…  n. 1. (利害)关系，所关切的事 2. 关心，担心，挂念 3. 商行，企业 || show concern for关心
words.example: The state of my father's health concerns us greatly.  我父亲的健康状况让我们非常担心。

words.meaning: n. 一连串，一系列，连续
words.example: There has been a series of sexual attacks on women in the area.  这个地区发生了一连串针对女性的性侵害案件。

words.meaning: adj. 1. 重要的，重大的 2. 有特殊意义的
words.example: There has been a significant increase in the number of women students in recent years.  近年来，女学生的人数有了显著增加。

words.meaning: adj. 相似的，近似的
words.example: My father and I have similar views on politics.  我和父亲在政治上观点相似。

words.meaning: n. 1. 回答 2. 反应
words.example: Responses to our advertisement have been disappointing.  人们对我们的广告反应平淡，令人失望。

words.meaning: n. 因素，要素
words.example: People's voting habits are influenced by political, social and economic factors.  人们的选举习惯受政治、社会和经济因素的影响。

words.meaning: n. 十年，十
words.example: Prices doubled in a decade.  价格十年间翻了一倍。

words.meaning: n. 1. 贮存，储备 2. 存货，现货 3. 股票 || stock certificate股票，证券 [stock dividend红利，股息] stock exchange证券交易所 /stock market股票市场
words.example: It is now halfway through winter and food stocks are already low.  现在冬天刚刚过半，但食物的储备已经不足。

words.meaning: n. 1. 侮辱，伤害 2. 恶意，怨恨 prep. 尽管，不顾，虽然
words.example: Despite repeated assurances that the product is safe, many people have stopped buying it.  尽管已反覆保证了该产品的安全性，很多人还是不再购买。

words.meaning: prep. 1. 在…之外，在…的更远处 2. 到…以后，晚于 3. 超出(能力，范围等) 4. 除了…之外
words.example: In the distance, beyond the river, was a small town.  在河对岸的远处有一座小镇。

words.meaning: v. 1. 靠近，接近 2. 与…打交道  3. 探讨，看待，处理 n. 1. 靠近，接近 2. 探讨，态度，方法
words.example: We could just see the train approaching in the distance.  我们刚好能看到火车从远处驶来。

words.meaning: n. 1. (pl)资金，存款，公债 2. 基金，专款，储备  v. 为…提供资金，资助，积累
words.example: The hospital has set up a special fund to buy new equipment.  医院专门设立了一项基金以购买新设备。

words.meaning: v. 发生，出现 || occur to(念头)出现(在某人的脑子里)，想到
words.example: An accident involving over ten vehicles has occurred in the east-bound lane.  在东向车道上发生了一起涉及十多辆汽车的交通事故。

words.meaning: n. 个人，个体 adj. 1. 单独的，个别的，个人的 2. 特有的，独特的
words.example: Every individual has rights which must never be taken away.  每个人都有一些不可剥夺的权利。

words.meaning: n. 1. 压力，气压 2. (精神上的)压力，压迫感
words.example: He put too much pressure on the door handle and it snapped.  他用力过猛，把门的把手弄断了。

words.meaning: v. 认明，识别，认同，鉴定
words.example: Even the smallest baby can identify its mother by her voice.  就连年龄最小的婴儿也能根据声音分辨出自己的母亲。

words.meaning: n. 疾病，弊病，病害  v. 使有病，使不健全
words.example: They reported a sudden outbreak of the disease in the south of the country.  他们报告说该国南部地区突然爆发了这种疾病。

words.meaning: v. 辩论，争论
words.example: The children are always arguing.  孩子老是吵个不停。

words.meaning: v. 1. 认出，辨认 2. 承认，认可，公认
words.example: Doctors are trained to recognize the symptoms of different diseases.  医生受过训练可以辨识出不同疾病的症状。(UK usually recognise) ['rek.əg.naɪz]

words.meaning: n. 1. 特性，性质，特征 2. (小说，戏剧等)人物，角色 3. 字，书写符号，印刷符号
words.example: Politeness is traditionally part of the British character.  待人礼貌客气向来是英国人性格的一部分。

words.meaning: n. 攻击，进攻，攻打 v. 攻击，进攻，侵袭
words.example: He was attacked and seriously injured by a gang of youths.  他被一帮年轻人打成重伤。

words.meaning: n. 1. 地区，区域 2. 领域，范围
words.example: He said he had sharp pains in the stomach region/the region of the stomach.  他说他的胃部剧痛。

words.meaning: (pl analyses) n. 分析，分解 || in the last (final) analysis归根结底，总而言之
words.example: Chemical analysis revealed a high content of copper.  化学分析结果显示出极高的铜含量。

words.meaning: n. 1. 利益，好处 2. 恩惠 3. 津贴，救济金，保险赔偿费 v. .有益于
words.example: The discovery of oil brought many benefits to the town.  石油的发现给该镇带来很多利益。

words.meaning: adj. 财政的，金融的 financially
words.example: financial difficulties/success  财政困难／经济上的成功

words.meaning: n. 罪行，罪恶
words.example: He has admitted committing several crimes, including two murders.  他供认犯过好几宗案件，包括两宗谋杀。

words.meaning: v. 1. 比较，对照 2. 比喻，比作 3. 比得上，相比 || compare to 把…比作 /compare with和…比较
words.example: If you compare house prices in the two areas, it's quite amazing how different they are.  如果比较一下两个地段的房价，你会惊讶地发现两者差别竟如此之大。

words.meaning: n. 1. 权，权力 2. 权威 3. (pl art)当局，官方 4. 职权，权限
words.example: The United Nations has used/exerted/exercised its authority to restore peace in the area.  联合国行使其权力以恢复该地区的和平。

words.meaning: n. & v. 1. 设计，图样，图案 2. 计划，图谋，打算 3. 构思，方案
words.example: Who designed this building/dress/furniture?  是谁设计这座建筑物／这款裙子／这套家俱？

words.meaning: n. 1. 战略(学)，策略(学)，兵法 2. 策略，谋略，妙计
words.example: The president held an emergency meeting to discuss military strategy with his defence commanders yesterday.  总统昨天召开紧急会议，和国防指挥官商讨军事战略。

words.meaning: n. 环境，周围状况
words.example: Certain chemicals have been banned because of their damaging effect on the environment.  一些化学品因对环境有破坏作用已被禁止使用。

words.meaning: adj. 1. 不同的，各种各样的 2. 多个的
words.example: We had various problems on our journey, including a puncture.  我们在旅途中遇到了各种各样的问题，包括轮胎被扎破了。

words.meaning: adj. 1. 执行的，实施的 2. 行政的，经营管理的 n. 1. 行政部门，(工会、党派等的)执行委员会 2. 执行者，行政人员，经理
words.example: She is now a senior executive, having worked her way up through the company.  她现在是高级行政主管，这是她在公司中一步一脚印爬上来的。

words.meaning: v. 1. (根据权利)要求，认领，索取 2. 声称，主张 n. 1. (根据权利而提出的)要求 2. (对某事物的)权利，所有权
words.example: All parties have claimed success in yesterday's elections.  所有党派都声称在昨天的选举中取得了胜利。

words.meaning: adj. 1. 法律上的 2. 合法的 3. 法定的
words.example: Is abortion legal in your country?  堕胎在你们国家是否合法？    Opposite illegaladjective

words.meaning: adj. 1. 宗教的，信仰宗教的 2. 虔诚的，敬畏神的
words.example: He's deeply religious and goes to church twice a week.  他非常虔诚，每周都去教堂做两次礼拜。

words.meaning: v. 1. 建立，设立，制订 2. 安置，安顿，确立 3. 确定，证实，规定 4. 使开业，使处于(某种位置、状况等)
words.example: The brewery was established in 1822.  这家啤酒厂建于1822年。

words.meaning: n. 1. 尝试，试验 2. 审讯，审判 3. 考验，磨难
words.example: Trial by jury is a fundamental right.  由陪审团审判是一项基本权利。

words.meaning: n. 专家，能手 adj. 熟练的，内行的，专家的
words.example: My mother is an expert at dress-making (= she does it very well).  我妈妈是做裁缝的高手。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n. 1. 管理，经营 2. 主管人员，管理部门
words.example: The company has suffered from several years of bad management.  公司数年来一直经营不善。

words.meaning: v. 避免，回避，躲开
words.example: The report studiously avoided any mention of the controversial plan.  这份报告有意避而不谈那个有争议的计划。

words.meaning: n. 1. 冲击(力)，撞击 2. 影响，效果
words.example: The impact of the crash reduced the car to a third of its original length.  撞车时的冲击力使车身变形，仅剩原来长度的三分之一。

words.meaning: v. 1. 作答，回答 2. 反应，回应
words.example: He responded by marching off and slamming the door behind him.  他的反应是大步走出房间，狠狠甩上了门。

words.meaning: n. 1. 陈述，声明 2. 财务报表 /报告书，结算表
words.example: The government is expected to issue a statement about the investigation to the press.  预计政府会就该调查向媒体作出说明。

words.meaning: v. 1. 维修，保养 2. 赡养，供养 3. 保持 4. 坚持认为，主张
words.example: The army has been brought in to maintain order in the region.  军队已调配到这个地区来维持秩序。

words.meaning: v. 1. 要(价)，收(费)，要(人)支付 2. 冲锋 3. 以某事指控某人，(指在法庭上)控告某人 n. 1. 费用，价钱，应付项目 2. 掌管，照管，监护 3. 负荷，电荷 4. 指控，控告，指责
words.example: How much/What do you charge for a haircut and blow-dry?  剪发和吹风要收多少钱？

words.meaning: v. 展现，显露，揭露
words.example: He was jailed for revealing secrets to the Russians.  他因为向俄国人泄密而被监禁。

words.meaning: n. 武器，兵器
words.example: The youths were dragged from their car and searched for weapons.  那些年轻人被从车里拖出来搜身，看是否携有武器。

words.meaning: v. 1. 申请，请求 2. 应用，施用，运用 3. 适用
words.example: By the time I saw the job advertised it was already too late to apply.  我看到招聘广告的时候，已经太晚了，错过了应征时机。

words.meaning: n. 1. 候选人 2. 应试者，应考者
words.example: There are three candidates standing in the election.  有三位候选人参加竞选。

words.meaning: n. 1. 讨论，会谈 2. (正式的)会议，讨论会
words.example: They frequently hold conferences at that hotel.  他们常在那家饭店举办会议。

words.meaning: adj. 1. 明确的，详尽的 2. 特定的，特指的
words.example: The virus attacks specific cells in the brain.  这种病毒专门攻击大脑内特定的细胞。

words.meaning: n. 1. 挑战，要求决斗，邀请比赛 2. 异议，质问怀疑 v. 1. 向…挑战 2. 对…表示异议， 非难， 怀疑
words.example: Finding a solution to this problem is one of the greatest challenges faced by scientists today.  寻找这个难题的解决办法是当今科学家所面临的最大挑战之一。

words.meaning: n. 1. (教育、慈善、医院等)社会公共机构 2. 建立，设立，制定 3. 制度，惯例，习俗
words.example: Oxford and Cambridge universities are internationally respected institutions.  牛津和剑桥是国际上备受尊崇的大学。UK noun

words.meaning: n. 1. 财产，所有物 2. 不动产，房地产 3. 性质，属性
words.example: The club does not accept responsibility for loss of or damage to club members' personal property.  该俱乐部不承担会员个人财产遗失或损坏的责任。

words.meaning: n. 1. 细节，琐事，详述 2. 分配，(人员的)选派 3. 选派的人(小组、分队等)  || go into detail(s)详细叙述，逐一说明 /in detail①详细地②逐渐地 v. 详细说明，派遣
words.example: She insisted on telling me every single detail of what they did to her in hospital.  她坚持要告诉我她在医院遭遇的一切。

words.meaning: v. 1. 反射，反映 2. 表达，表现 3. 考虑，思考
words.example: He saw himself reflected in the water/mirror/shop window.  他在水中／镜子里／商店橱窗玻璃上看到了自己的影像。

words.meaning: n. 1. 图案，花样 2. 方式，模式
words.example: The pattern of family life has been changing over recent years.  近年来家庭生活的模式一直在变化。

words.meaning: adj. 商业(上)的，商务的 n. 电台(电视)中的广告节目
words.example: The commercial future of the company looks very promising.  这家公司的商业前景看起来非常光明。

words.meaning: n. 癌，癌症
words.example: He died of liver cancer.  他死于肝癌。

words.meaning: n. 1. 条，项目，条款 2. (新闻等的)一条，一则
words.example: The restaurant has a long menu of about 50 items.  这家餐馆的菜单很长，大约有50道菜。

words.meaning: adj. 1. 确定的，明确的 2. 确信的 3. 积极的，有效的 4. 正极的，阳性的
words.example: On a more positive note, we're seeing signs that the housing market is picking up.  更乐观地说，我们看到了房地产市场正在好转的迹象。

words.meaning: n. 消费者
words.example: The new telephone rates will affect all consumers including businesses.  新的电话费率会影响到所有用户，包括工商企业。

words.meaning: n. 1. 预算 2. 金额，预算拨款 v. 编制预算，安排开支
words.example: The firm has drawn up a budget for the coming financial year.  公司草拟了下一财政年度的预算方案。

words.meaning: n. 1. (祭神的)牺牲品，祭品 2. 牺牲者，受害者，受灾者
